basics.name: Sandeep kumar
basics.label: Backend Engineer | Full Stack Engineer
basics.summary: Backend and Full Stack Engineer with 1.8 years of experience taking product features from requirements to production with Python (FastAPI, Django), Node.js, React, PostgreSQL and AWS. Practices spec-driven development with AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Kiro), turning requirements into clear specs before building software that solves real problems for the teams who use it. Open to relocation and remote. Available immediately.

work.name: HLM
work.summary: Designed and shipped FastAPI REST APIs and microservices powering the employee experience and HR workflow modules for a platform serving 12,000 employees.
responsibilities: Designed and shipped FastAPI REST APIs and microservices on Python and PostgreSQL with JWT authentication, Redis and Docker Compose. These power the employee experience and HR workflow modules for a platform serving 12,000 employees.

Owned the new medical insurance module end to end. It's a 5-stage workflow (enrolment, premium management, employee acceptance, e-card upload, document download) with PostgreSQL stage tracking and AWS S3 file storage.
Built the new reward disbursement feature. Managers evaluate, score and approve contributions by category, and employees redeem points for payouts or vouchers (2 redemption options).

Built a reusable push-notification service so every HR module can alert employees without extra backend work. Alerts are queued in Redis and delivered with Firebase Cloud Messaging, and requirements were turned into specs before coding.

work.name: Avasoft
work.summary: Shipped invoice processing and operations features for enterprise products used by 1,000+ daily staff users.
responsibilities: Cut the operations team's Opstream invoice processing time by 40% for about 2,000 purchase orders a week. The new feature normalizes 5 ERP-specific JSON formats into one PostgreSQL schema.

Shipped new Racpad features for 1,000+ daily staff users, including parcel pickup and drop-off assignment and delivery receipts in US English and Mexican Spanish behind feature flags. Built with React, Node.js microservices and JWT.
Wrote Jest unit tests with mocked dependencies for Racpad's Node.js APIs in Agile Scrum sprints.

work.name: Avasoft
work.summary: Built the Absence Tracker end to end, a secret-scanning pre-commit hook, and React and Node.js features for enterprise projects.
responsibilities: Owned the new Absence Tracker end to end. It gives 500+ employees one workflow for leave requests and gives approvers a multi-stage approval and status view.
Built git-warden, a Go CLI pre-commit hook that scans for 50+ credential patterns and blocks commits that leak secrets.
Implemented AWS CloudWatch logging and monitoring and improved GitLab CI/CD pipelines.
Built React and Node.js features, refactored 8 React components and reviewed teammates' code.

projects.name: PG Management SaaS
projects.description: A multi-tenant platform for hostel/PG owners, wardens and tenants that digitizes rent collection, with an income dashboard, a tenant grievance portal and role-based access for super admin, owner and warden.
highlights: 🏗️ Layered FastAPI backend with JWT, rate limiting and Alembic migrations
📊 Indexed PostgreSQL queries for rent and electricity invoicing, partial payments and defaulter tracking
🔐 Role-based access for super admin, owner and warden
✅ Tested with 73 pytest tests and Playwright E2E tests

projects.name: git-warden
projects.description: A cross-platform CLI pre-commit hook that blocks commits which would leak secrets.
highlights: 🔍 Scans staged Git diffs with entropy analysis and regex rules
🔑 Detects 50+ credential patterns (AWS, OpenAI, Stripe, Slack)
🛑 Blocks commits that would leak secrets
